name: Signs Of The End Times
overview: Scripture reveals that the end times will be marked by increased knowledge and global activity, as Daniel was told many will run to and fro and knowledge will increase. Jesus describes signs including wars, famines, pestilences, and earthquakes, cautioning believers not to be troubled as these events must occur before the end. The gospel will be preached to all nations as a final witness before the end comes, yet the exact day and hour remain known only to the Father. These signs emphasize both the certainty and the divine mystery surrounding the timing of Christ’s return.
